response.original_title: เธอ ฉัน ฝัน เรา You & I in Our Dream
response.overview: After years of dating, Ai finally dreams of Yu proposing to him. He is excitedly anxious and spends his whole trip anticipating Yu's every move, thinking he's finally going to pop the question.....so why does it feel like an impending break up instead!?
